findings.title: Food separated and protected.
findings.comment: Observed eggs to be stored above beef in walk in cooler. Discussed with PIC, proper storage order education was provided and eggs were moved to below beef. Ensure proper storage order is maintained to prevent any possible contamination.
findings.citation_text: 3-302.11(A)(2) Packaged and Unpackaged Food - Separation, Packaging, and Segregation. (A) FOOD shall be protected from cross contamination by: (2) Except when combined as ingredients, separating types of raw animal FOODS from each other such as beef, FISH, lamb, pork, and POULTRY during storage, preparation, holding, and display by: (a) Using separate EQUIPMENT for each type, or (b) Arranging each type of FOOD in EQUIPMENT so that cross contamination of one type with another is prevented, and (c) Preparing each type of FOOD at different times or in separate areas.

findings.title: Contamination prevented during food preparation, storage and display.
findings.comment: Observed food items to be stored with no overhead covering available. Discussed with PIC, lids/wrapping was placed on top of open containers. Ensure food items are protected in a way that prevents any possible contamination.
findings.citation_text: 3-306.11 Food Display. Except for nuts in the shell and whole, raw fruits and vegetables that are intended for hulling, peeling, or washing by the CONSUMER before consumption, FOOD on display shall be protected from contamination by the use of PACKAGING; counter, service line, or salad bar FOOD guards; display cases; or other effective means.

findings.title: Food and non-food contact surfaces cleanable, properly designed, constructed, and used.
findings.comment: Observed ice accumulation to be present under fan unit in walk in freezer. Discussed with PIC, freezer will be serviced. Ensure equipment is in a state of repair that meets the manufactures standards,
findings.citation_text: 4-501.11(A) Good Repair and Proper Adjustment. (A) EQUIPMENT shall be maintained in a state of repair and condition that meets the requirements specified under Parts 4-1 and 4-2.

findings.title: Plumbing installed; proper backflow devices.
findings.comment: Observed small leak to be present at triple sink faucet. Discussed with PIC, faucet will be serviced. Ensure a licensed plumber services faucet.
findings.citation_text: 5-205.15(B) System Maintained in Good Repair. A plumbing system shall be: (B) Maintained in good repair.

findings.title: Contamination prevented during food preparation, storage and display.
findings.comment: Observed multiple sauce containers throughout kitchen to be resting on floor. Discussed with PIC, sauces will be moved to at least 6 inches off floor. Ensure any food item is kept at least 6 inches off of floor.
findings.citation_text: 3-305.11(A) Food Storage. (A) Except as specified in (B) and (C) of this section, FOOD shall be protected from contamination by storing the FOOD: (1) In a clean, dry location; (2) Where it is not exposed to splash, dust, or other contamination; and (3) At least 15 cm (6 inches) above the floor.

findings.title: Contamination prevented during food preparation, storage and display.
findings.comment: Observed cooked rice to be kept in a plastic non food grade bag. Discussed with PIC, education was provided on proper food grade bags and rice was discarded. Ensure facility is containing food in food grade quality container.
findings.citation_text: 3-307.11 Miscellaneous Sources of Contamination. FOOD shall be protected from contamination that may result from a factor or source not specified under Subparts 3-301 - 3-306.

findings.title: Adequate handwashing sinks properly supplied and accessible.
findings.comment: Observed a trash can to be blocking kitchen hand sink. Discussed with PIC, trash can was relocated. Ensure hand washing stations are kept accessible to encourage hand washing.
findings.citation_text: 5-205.11 Using a Handwashing Sink. (A) A HANDWASHING SINK shall be maintained so that it is accessible at all times for EMPLOYEE use. (B) A HANDWASHING SINK may not be used for purposes other than handwashing. (C) An automatic handwashing facility shall be used in accordance with manufacturer’s instructions.

findings.title: Proper hot holding temperatures.
findings.comment: Observed a container of won ton soup to be hot holding at 110F. Discussed with PIC, inspector recommended soup be moved to stove for reheating, however staff threw soup away and prepared a new batch. Ensure any TCS food being hot held is kept at or above 135F.
findings.citation_text: 3-501.16(A)(1) Time/Temperature Control for Safety Food, Hot and Cold Holding. (A) Except during preparation, cooking, or cooling, or when time is used as the public health control as specified under §3-501.19, and except as specified under (B) and in (C) of this section, TIME/TEMPERATURE CONTROL FOR SAFETY FOOD shall be maintained: (1) At 57°C (135°F) or above, except that roasts cooked to a temperature and for a time specified in 3-401.11(B) or reheated as specified in 3-403.11(E) may be held at a temperature of 54°C (130°F) or above.

findings.title: Proper cold holding temperatures
findings.comment:
Observed the drive thru prep table cooler to be holding temperatures of 56F. Discussed with PIC, prep table cooler will no longer be used and a call was placed to service cooler. After further discussion with PIC, items were placed in cooler roughly 2 hours before, however items were discarded by staff. Ensure any cold holding equipment is able to cold hold items below 41F. 

3-501.16: (A) (2) TCS FOOD shall be maintained at 41F or less. (B) EGGS not treated to destroy Salmonellae shall be stored at 45F or less.

findings.title: Proper cold holding temperatures
findings.comment:
3-501.16: (A) (2) TCS FOOD shall be maintained at 41F or less. (B) EGGS not treated to destroy Salmonellae shall be stored at 45F or less. 

Observed the main prep cooler across from the wok line to be an ambient temperature of ~55F per the hanging thermometer in the back of  the bottom of the cooler. Top prep cooler items probed: chicken - 54F, shrimp - 57F, cooked chicken - 56F. Bottom prep cooler items probed: crab - 55F, scallops - 57F. Prep cooler appears to have a temperature issue. AirMasters is the service provider for the facility. Inspector instructed PIC to call AirMasters to schedule an appointment to fix the cooler. Facility has a probe style thermometer to check internal temperatures. Utilize the thermometer to check food temperatures. Cooler should not be used until repaired (top and bottom - do not use cooler at all). Items voluntarily discarded included: scallops, shrimp, chicken, steak, crab, and pork.

Inspector will follow-up on 8/8/23.

findings.title: Warewashing facilities: installed, maintained, & used; test strips
findings.comment:
4-303.11: (A) Cleaning agents used to clean EQUIPMENT shall be provided and available during all hours of operation. (B) Chemical SANITIZERS shall be provided and available during all hours of operation. 

(REPEAT) Observed the kitchen sani bucket to have 0 ppm of bleach - just soapy water and rags. Discussed with PIC. PIC made a new bleach sani bucket upon request. 200 ppm. Ensure an active sani bucket with rags is present during all operational hours and the concentration stays within limits (bleach - 50 to 200 ppm). COS. This is a repeat violation since the last routine inspection on 11/22/22.

findings.title: Utensils, equipment & linens: properly stored, dried, & handled
findings.comment:
4-904.11: (A) cleaned and SANITIZED UTENSILS shall be handled, displayed, and dispensed to prevent FOOD- and lip-contact surface contamination.

Two pairing knives are observed stored between the magnetic rack and the wall to the right of the woks. Inspector indicated that this space was not easily cleanable and therefore was not a safe location to store food contact surfaces. The knives were moved to dish and will be stored on the front of the magnet moving foreword.

findings.title: Warewashing facilities: installed, maintained, & used; test strips
findings.comment:
4-303.11: (A) Cleaning agents used to clean EQUIPMENT shall be provided and available during all hours of operation. (B) Chemical SANITIZERS shall be provided and available during all hours of operation. 

On arrival, there was not a bucket of sanitizer available in the kitchen area and foods were being prepared/ handled. PIC was consulted and a bucket was made during the inspection to correct the violation. PIC indicated that there was a bucket that was discarded after the lunch rush ended and had not been remade yet. Sanitizers should be available at all times that foods are being prepared in the facility.

findings.title: Hands clean and properly washed
findings.comment: 2-301.12: Observed employee use bare hands to shut off faucet. Discussed with staff. Ensure hands are washed for 20 seconds with soap and water, and use paper towel to shut off faucet to avoid re-contaminating hands. Inspector will touch on handwashing at follow up.

findings.title: No bare hand contact with RTE food or a pre-approved alternative procedure properly allowed
findings.comment: 3-801.11: Observed employee chopping broccoli with bare hands. Discussed with staff. Ensure employees are wearing gloves when chopping vegetables/RTE foods. COS- employee washed hands and put on gloves.

findings.title: Adequate handwashing sinks properly supplied and accessible
findings.comment:
5-205.11: (A) A HANDWASHING SINK shall be maintained so that it is accessible at all times for EMPLOYEE use. 

Upon inspector arrival, Trash observed blocking handsink in kitchen. COS- discussed with person in charge. Ensure nothing blocks employee access to handwashing in the kitchen. Person in charge moved the trash can so it is accessible.

findings.title: Food-contact surfaces; cleaned and sanitized
findings.comment: 4-501.114: After several attempts to run the dish machine, the test strips registered at 0ppm. Inspector unable to see sanitizer passing through lines upon priming. See that the dish machine is serviced by follow up date.

findings.title: Non-food contact surfaces clean
findings.comment: 4-602.13: Observed dust build up on fans in walk-in refrigerator. Ensure fan pieces are removed and cleaned as needed to prevent soil buildup. Discussed with PIC.

findings.title: Adequate handwashing sinks properly supplied and accessible
findings.comment:
5-205.11: (A) A HANDWASHING SINK shall be maintained so that it is accessible at all times for EMPLOYEE use. 

Upon inspector arrival, Trash observed blocking handsink in kitchen. COS- discussed with person in charge. Ensure nothing blocks employee access to handwashing in the kitchen. Person in charge moved the trash can so it is accessible.

findings.title: Contamination prevented during food preparation, storage and display
findings.comment:
3-306.12: (A) Condiments shall be protected from contamination. 

Ensure all raw meats and eggs are stored below ready to eat foods, including sauces and condiments. Observed whole shell eggs stored above individually packaged condiments in walk-in cooler. Discussed with person in charge, see that eggs are placed below sauces and other ready to eat foods.

findings.title: Toxic substances properly identified, stored, and used
findings.comment:
7-202.12: (A) POISONOUS MATERIALS shall be used according to LAW(C), Manufacturer’s directions (indicate for use in FOOD ESTABLISHMENT) (P), conditions of certification (if applicable) (P),

Sanitizer bucket of bleach water appeared to be bubbly, as if mixed with soap. Upon testing, 0ppm Cl- observed. PIC stated there is bleach and soap mixed together. COS- education provided. Ensure bleach sanitizer buckets are made according to product label and not mixed with any other cleansers or detergents. PIC made a sanitizer bucket of bleach and water to 200ppm.

findings.title: Physical facilities installed, maintained, and clean
findings.comment:
6-501.11: PHYSICAL FACILITIES shall be maintained in good repair. 

The following surfaces have either cracked or molded caulking, caulking needs replaced: hand sink in kitchen where attaches to wall, and dish machine area, where it is attached to wall. Will follow up at next routine inspection.
